plate_comment: The 48RE low range (transfer case in low) governor pressure strategy: cm848_runTransmissionControl runs it in low range above transmission_low_range_minimum_throttle. Every cal it reads is an e2m RE_Low_Range_* record: the boost times after the 1-2 / 2-3 shift, the engine acceleration limits that stop the boost, the minimum hold times, the 1-2 shift detection speed; it predicts the shift engine speed from transmission_engine_acceleration and transmission_predicted_1_2_shift_delay. Pressure states 0xb-0xf (was cm848_protectionOverloadHandler)
Counts down the 48RE controller's timers each pass (the anti-hunt, lockup delay, low range, WOT boost and overdrive inhibit timers of e2m 8C17) (was cm848_decrementProtectionTimers)

Initializes the 48RE controller: transmission_current_gear = 1, the maximum engine speeds and previous values cleared, the overdrive off flag cleared, and the other e2m 8C17 working words (was cm848_initProtectionSystem)

Every scan period: the output shaft speed change into transmission_output_shaft_acceleration_unfiltered (e2m RE_OSS_Accel_Unfiltered) and its filtered value transmission_output_shaft_acceleration (RE_OSS_Accel) (was cm848_filterProtectionLoadValue)

The governor pressure sensor offset calibration (e2m 8C17 RE_Init_Cal_Delay / RE_Cal_Timer / RE_Between_Cal_Timer: 'Timer used in trans gov press offset calibration'): under algorithm_enable_flags_6_cal bit 2 it sets governor_pressure_sensor_zero_offset (was protectionPhaseGroupA_Init)
